hypothesis: On Binance USDS-M perpetual launches whose asset was first listed on MEXC, the MEXC run-up over the 24 h ending at the last complete hour before the Binance announcement orders the fade of the Binance perpetual between t0+15 min and t0+6 h (short, raw); in the high-run-up group (>= +20 %) the mean net fade exceeds 3x the measured taker cost at 500 $.
economic_reason: Holders accumulated on MEXC without a liquid short path; the Binance perpetual brings leverage, short access and a reference price. The move that was bought on MEXC is sold back once it can be shorted. Nobody is forced to trade: a crowd-positioning story, hence a forward-only ceiling.

entry_rule.event_selection: population.json (84 events): MEXC_FIRST, not BAD_TIMESTAMP, pre_announcement_return_24h defined (>= 20 complete MEXC hourly closes before the announcement), effective spread measured at +15 min (slippage imputed at the population median for 5, flagged); HIGH = variable >= +0.20 (30), LOW = 54, lists frozen by sha256
entry_rule.entry_at: tradable_start + 15 min (open of the first 1-min bar >= entry time, tolerance 5 min, else excluded and counted); t0 = tradable_start_ts = first Vision bar

exit_rule.exit_at: tradable_start + 6 h (open of the first bar >= exit time, tolerance 5 min; missing exit = excluded and counted)

cost_model.notes: per event in the harness: 2 x 5 bps taker (official VIP0, tier confirmed by the spot account, BNB discount not applied: decision P13) + own effective spread at +15 min + own sell+buy slippage at 500 $ (P11, official_published; imputed for 5); mean round trip 26.6 bps (HIGH 22.9). Realised funding received by the short at settlements in (entry, exit] enters the net. The spread/slippage numbers here are population medians for the schema; the harness uses per-event values.

validation_window.nature: FORWARD-ONLY: events with t0 after the seal timestamp (LOOK_LEDGER seal entry, branch prereg/mexc-to-binance-v1-forward, 2026-09-13); one look when >= 60 eligible or on 2028-09-12; the historical period 2017-07-21 -> 2026-09-10 is burned for the news family and no historical read is authorized

declustering_rule.note: 84 distinct launch days: cluster-robust SE equals iid SE

kill_criteria.placebo_veto: veto-eligible placebo with n >= 30, t >= 1.0 and gross >= 50 % of HIGH gross, or not computable

promotion_criteria.primary: spearman(pre_announcement_return_24h, short gross raw 6h return) on all measured events, one-sided rho > 0, permutation p <= 0.05/6 (20 000 seeded permutations)
promotion_criteria.economic_gate: HIGH mean net >= 3 x mean cost(HIGH), reported with iid SE; t on the gross series, not tested
